solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Homing bird with letter from Greece has gone astray

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: going astray means wandering off course, so the letters of gone wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A homing bird carrying a letter from Greece has lost its way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Homing' looks like part of the surface story about the bird losing its way, but it belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The racing variety of this common bird is bred to fly back to its loft, hence a homing bird.

clue.text: Under pressure, reportedly get sick twice with beer

indicators.note: in a down clue the rest sits under the letter for pressure

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for pressure

indicators.note: twice means the word for get sick is written two times over
reportedly means as heard, so the word for get sick is spoken

parts.note: to ail is to be sick or unwell

explanation.surface: Under strain, someone is sick twice after drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: This light-coloured bitter is a style of beer brewed with pale malt.

clue.text: Stop paying attention to Brexiteer, adopting idle resistance

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so the word for idle goes inside the politician's name

parts.note: Michael Gove was a leading campaigner for Britain to leave the EU
to laze is to idle
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: People tune out a Brexit campaigner who takes up idle resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: Michael Gove is a British Conservative politician who was a leading figure in the 2016 Leave campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: When eyes take on a dull blank look, the idiom says someone has lost interest.

clue.text: Pimlico flat exit locked up recently

indicators.note: locked up means shut inside, so the letters sit within the phrase

explanation.surface: The exit of a Pimlico flat was locked a short while ago.
explanation.walkthrough: Pimlico is a district of central London.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means lately, in the recent past, a synonym.

clue.text: Seethed after revolutionary agent's given bouquet

indicators.note: the word for seethed is placed after the reversed agent
a revolutionary turns things round, so the word for agent is written backwards

parts.note: a rep, short for representative, is a sales agent
to seethe with anger is to fume

explanation.surface: Someone fumed after a revolutionary's agent was handed a bunch of flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bouquet' suggests flowers, but here it is a scent, as with wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Bouquet also means a pleasant smell, so something given a bouquet has been scented.

clue.text: Former morning paper

parts.note: ex means former

explanation.surface: A newspaper that used to come out in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'morning paper' looks like a newspaper; paper is a test.
explanation.definitionFit: A test sat at school or university is called a paper, as in a maths paper.

clue.text: Rose perhaps welcoming old Liberal supporter

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the letters for old and Liberal go inside

parts.note: a rose is an example of a flower

explanation.surface: A rose bush hosting a backer of the old Liberal Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A fan or adherent who supports a cause or person is a synonym.

clue.text: Low stable housing for animal

parts.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do

indicators.note: the housing of the word is its outer shell, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A cow lows in a stable that houses livestock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low' is the verb for a cow's call, not 'not high'.
explanation.definitionFit: This large deer of North America is an example of an animal.

clue.text: Number heading off on day away eat in restaurant

indicators.note: on means added onto, so the number is attached to the letter for day
heading off means losing its first letter

parts.note: nine is a number
out means away, as in out of the office

explanation.surface: A number disappears on a day out.
explanation.definitionFit: To dine is to eat a meal, and doing so away from home means at a restaurant.

clue.text: Legally responsible for label about iodine inside

indicators.note: the iodine symbol goes inside the rearranged label
about can mean in a disordered way, so the letters of label are moved around

parts.note: I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A product's label carries legal warnings about the iodine it contains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges LABEL to LABLE; 'inside' puts I in after the first L.
explanation.definitionFit: Being answerable in law for a debt or harm is the legal sense of the word, a close synonym.

clue.text: Everyone's sad after fellow's come unstuck

indicators.note: the words for everyone and sad come after the letter for fellow

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS
all means everyone
feeling down means feeling sad

explanation.surface: Everybody is miserable now that some chap's plans have failed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are idioms for a plan or argument failing or collapsing under scrutiny.

clue.text: Ideal man may possess posh car

indicators.note: possess means hold inside, so the letters for the car go inside

parts.note: might is the past form of may, as in may or might go
RR stands for Rolls-Royce, a luxury car

explanation.surface: The perfect partner might own a fancy car.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names the perfect partner a woman hopes to find.

clue.text: Opening with a quiet introductory piece, nothing very abandoned

parts.note: p, for piano, is the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: abandoned means left behind, so the letters for nothing and very are dropped

parts.note: an overture is the orchestral piece introducing an opera
O, the round figure zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: A musical opening played softly, with an overture that has been cut entirely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' takes O and V out of OVERTURE, leaving ERTURE.
explanation.definitionFit: A gap or hole that lets light or air through, as in a camera lens, is a synonym for an opening.

clue.text: Hat won out over jacket

indicators.note: out means left out, so the letter for won is removed

parts.note: a bowler is a hard round hat
W is the abbreviation for won in sports tables
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: A hat won out over a jacket in a contest of fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' removes W from BOWLER, giving BOLER.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a short open jacket ending above the waist, worn by Spanish dancers.

clue.text: Question purpose when finally leaving band

indicators.note: leaving means going away, so that letter is removed from the purpose word

parts.note: intent is purpose

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of when

explanation.surface: Questioning the point when a group is quitting at last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' drops N (the last letter of 'when') from INTENT, giving INTET.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of five musicians playing together is a type of band.

clue.text: Covet even hollow victory ending in controversy

indicators.note: hollow means emptied of the middle, so only the outside letters of even remain
ending in points to the final letter of controversy

explanation.surface: A rival wants even a hollow win at the close of a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: To covet is to desire what someone else has, which is resentful longing, the verb's synonym.

clue.text: Junior officer renting French place?

parts.note: lieu is the French word for place
a tenant is one renting a property

explanation.surface: A young officer is renting a place in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that 'renting' stands for a person who rents, not the act itself.
explanation.definitionFit: This rank sits below captain in the army, a junior commissioned officer.

clue.text: Harmony at home's broken by love for squeezebox!

parts.note: accord is harmony or agreement

indicators.note: the at-home word is broken open by the love letter going inside

parts.note: in means at home
O is love, zero in tennis

explanation.surface: Domestic peace is shattered by love of the squeezebox.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken by' puts O inside IN, giving ION.
explanation.definitionFit: Squeezebox is the informal name for this bellows-driven keyboard instrument.

clue.text: Vessels rise and tip in device to control water supply

indicators.note: in a down clue rise means read upwards, so the vessels word is read in reverse

parts.note: pots are vessels
to cock is to tip or tilt, as in cocking a hat

explanation.surface: Vessels rise and tip inside a plumbing device.
explanation.definitionFit: This valve on a pipe turns the mains supply on or off.

clue.text: Early in the morning light's good behind trees and model

indicators.note: the words for light and good come behind the trees and model

parts.note: firs are conifers
the Model T was Ford's famous car
thin can mean light, as in a thin or light fabric

explanation.surface: Dawn light looks lovely behind the trees and a posing model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light's good' reads as praise for the dawn, but it is THIN plus G.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means at the very start of the day, before anything else is done.

clue.text: Pedant's loudly taking issue about cutting edges on grass

indicators.note: the grass word comes on after the rest

parts.note: f, for forte, means loudly in music

indicators.note: about means in a muddle, so the remaining letters of issue are turned around
cutting the edges removes the first and last letters of issue

parts.note: pot is slang for marijuana, also called grass

explanation.surface: A pedant loudly objects to someone trimming the lawn edges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting edges' leaves SSU from ISSUE, rearranged by 'about' to USS. The definition reads as 'Pedant is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A fussy, overparticular person, a stickler for detail, is a near synonym of a pedant.

clue.text: Husband's come out of terrible crash with permanent mark

indicators.note: a terrible crash is a wreck, so its letters are mangled into a new order
coming out of means leaving, so the letter for husband is removed

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A husband has emerged from an awful car crash with a lasting wound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come out of' takes H from CRASH, leaving CRAS, which 'terrible' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: The mark left on skin after a wound heals often lasts for life.

clue.text: Looks at way to close communications

definitions.meaning: to regard something is to look at it
best wishes is a common sign-off ending a letter or email

explanation.surface: Studying a manner of ending messages.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means views or considers, and the plural noun ends a letter as kind wishes.

clue.text: Watch priest during church sermon

indicators.note: the priest's letter comes during the watching word, inside it

parts.note: to see is to watch

explanation.surface: Observe a priest in church giving a sermon.
explanation.definitionFit: A sermon is a formal address, a talk given to a gathered audience.

clue.text: Play heartless game to get ahead quick

indicators.note: the game is placed ahead of the heartless play

parts.note: snap is a card game

indicators.note: heartless means the middle is removed, keeping the outside letters of play

explanation.surface: Play a cruel game to get ahead fast.
explanation.walkthrough: SNAP is a children's card game where players shout 'snap' at matching cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Snappy means brisk or fast, as in make it snappy, a synonym of quick.

clue.text: Came to wonder about agreement

indicators.note: about means around, so the wonder word goes around the agreement word

parts.note: awe is wonder
OK expresses agreement

explanation.surface: Someone reached a sense of wonder about a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to is to regain consciousness, which is to stop sleeping.

clue.text: Bound for potential glory at first in game

parts.note: a bound is a leap

indicators.note: potential means something that may become something else, so the letters of for are rearranged
at first takes the opening letter of glory

explanation.surface: A team heading for possible glory in a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound for' reads as heading for, but 'Bound' is LEAP and 'potential' rearranges FOR to FRO.
explanation.definitionFit: This children's game involves vaulting over others who are bent down.

clue.text: Accompany building janitor getting rid of rat

indicators.note: building means constructing, so the letters are rearranged into something new
getting rid of means the letters of rat are removed from the pool

explanation.surface: The building's janitor is getting rid of a rat.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove R, A and T from JANITOR and rearrange the remaining JNIO.
explanation.definitionFit: To join someone is to go with them, a synonym of accompany.

clue.text: Expert's caught blocking apparatus of official procedure

parts.note: a pro is an expert

indicators.note: the caught letter blocks the apparatus by sitting inside it

parts.note: a tool is a piece of apparatus
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An expert has been caught obstructing the machinery of official process.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blocking' puts C inside TOOL, giving TOCOL.
explanation.definitionFit: The formal rules of etiquette governing diplomatic or state occasions are a set procedure.

clue.text: High-ranking Spanish gentleman's taken over island

indicators.note: the island letter is taken into the Spanish word, which closes over it

parts.note: señor is Spanish for a gentleman

explanation.surface: A lofty Spanish aristocrat has seized an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Being higher in rank or status, as a senior officer is, is the adjective's sense.

clue.text: Making fine adjustments with delicate cutting can take guts initially

indicators.note: the word for delicate cuts into the can, splitting it

parts.note: a tin is a can
weak can mean delicate or frail

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of guts

explanation.surface: Fine-tuning by delicate surgery takes courage at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like a verb but is the noun for a tin; 'with' and 'take' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweak is to make a small precise change, so tweaking is the present participle.

clue.text: His new organisation gets complaints

indicators.note: an organisation is an ordering, so these letters are set in fresh order

explanation.surface: His new company receives grievances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' rearranges HIS and NEW.
explanation.definitionFit: Whines are peevish grumbles, a plural noun synonym for complaints.
